default.notes: A visa from a Montenegrin embassy is required — though holders of a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit can enter without one for up to 30 days.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. EU citizens can also enter with a national ID card for short stays of up to 30 days.
Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Visa-free for up to 90 days — neighbouring Western Balkan citizens can also enter with a national ID card for short stays.

ME.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Montenegrin citizens.

RU.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days. In past summer seasons the allowance was temporarily extended and terms change — confirm the current rules before travel.

CN.notes: Seasonal and reciprocal visa waivers have applied to Chinese citizens in recent years — confirm the current rules with a Montenegrin embassy before travel.
